---
title: Colors
description: "JK-UI color system: shadcn-standard tokens, theme modes, and CSS variables."
---

JK-UI uses **shadcn-standard CSS variable names** consumed through Tailwind v4 `@theme` utilities. All color values are semantic tokens, never hardcoded.

## Prerequisites

Make sure `jk-ui-cli setup` has run and generated your `jk-ui-theme.css`. This file defines the CSS variables and `@theme inline` mappings for your chosen theme.

## Token Reference

### shadcn-Standard Tokens

| Variable | Description | Tailwind Class |
|----------|-------------|----------------|
| `--background` | Page background | `bg-background` |
| `--foreground` | Default text color | `text-foreground` |
| `--card` | Card background | `bg-card` |
| `--card-foreground` | Card text | `text-card-foreground` |
| `--popover` | Popover/dropdown background | `bg-popover` |
| `--popover-foreground` | Popover text | `text-popover-foreground` |
| `--primary` | Brand color | `bg-primary` |
| `--primary-foreground` | Text on primary | `text-primary-foreground` |
| `--secondary` | Secondary brand | `bg-secondary` |
| `--secondary-foreground` | Text on secondary | `text-secondary-foreground` |
| `--muted` | Subtle background | `bg-muted` |
| `--muted-foreground` | Muted text | `text-muted-foreground` |
| `--accent` | Accent color | `bg-accent` |
| `--accent-foreground` | Text on accent | `text-accent-foreground` |
| `--destructive` | Destructive actions | `bg-destructive` |
| `--destructive-foreground` | Text on destructive | `text-destructive-foreground` |
| `--border` | Default border | `border-border` |
| `--input` | Input border | `border-input` |
| `--ring` | Focus ring | `ring-ring` |
| `--radius` | Border radius | `rounded-lg` |

### Semantic State Tokens

| Variable | Description | Tailwind Class |
|----------|-------------|----------------|
| `--success` | Success states | `text-success` / `bg-success` |
| `--warning` | Warning states | `text-warning` / `bg-warning` |
| `--info` | Informational states | `text-info` / `bg-info` |

### Extended jk-ui Tokens

| Variable | Description | Tailwind Class |
|----------|-------------|----------------|
| `--fg-title` | High-emphasis headings | `text-fg-title` |
| `--fg-subtitle` | Sub-headings | `text-fg-subtitle` |
| `--bg` | Default background (alias `--background`) | `bg-bg` |
| `--bg-subtle` | Subtle section backgrounds | `bg-bg-subtle` |
| `--bg-surface` | Elevated surfaces | `bg-bg-surface` |
| `--bg-muted` | Muted backgrounds | `bg-bg-muted` |
| `--overlay` | Modal/drawer overlays (alias `--popover`) | `bg-overlay` |
| `--border-strong` | Stronger borders | `border-border-strong` |
| `--border-card` | Card borders | `border-border-card` |
| `--border-input` | Input borders (alias `--input`) | `border-border-input` |

### Chart Tokens

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `--chart-1` | Chart series 1 |
| `--chart-2` | Chart series 2 |
| `--chart-3` | Chart series 3 |
| `--chart-4` | Chart series 4 |
| `--chart-5` | Chart series 5 |

## Theme Modes

JK-UI supports choosing your color scheme during setup:

| Mode | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `both` | Full light and dark variable sets. Recommended. |
| `light` | Light mode only. |
| `dark` | Dark mode only. |

The `jk-ui-cli setup` command prompts you to choose and generates the appropriate CSS.

## @theme Registration

Tokens are registered in `@theme inline` so Tailwind generates the utility classes:

```css
@theme inline {
  --color-background: var(--background);
  --color-foreground: var(--foreground);
  --color-primary: var(--primary);
  --color-secondary: var(--secondary);
  --color-muted: var(--muted);
  --color-muted-foreground: var(--muted-foreground);
  --color-accent: var(--accent);
  --color-destructive: var(--destructive);
  --color-border: var(--border);
  --color-input: var(--input);
  --color-ring: var(--ring);
  --radius: var(--radius);
  /* extended tokens */
  --color-fg-title: var(--fg-title);
  --color-fg-subtitle: var(--fg-subtitle);
  --color-bg-subtle: var(--bg-subtle);
  --color-bg-surface: var(--bg-surface);
  --color-bg-muted: var(--bg-muted);
  --color-border-strong: var(--border-strong);
  --color-success: var(--success);
  --color-warning: var(--warning);
  --color-info: var(--info);
}
```

Once registered, use `bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `border-input`, `ring-ring`, etc. throughout the UI.
